title: Anticancer Activity, DNA Binding, and Photodynamic Properties of a NwedgeCwedgeN-Coordinated Pt(II) Complex.
authors: Scoditti, Stefano; Dabbish, Eslam; Russo, Nino; Mazzone, Gloria; Sicilia, Emilia
one_liner_zh: 该文用DFT/TD-DFT和MD模拟研究Pt(II)配合物与DNA的结合及光动力性质，属广义蛋白-DNA互作外的金属-DNA体系，方法可迁移至TF-DNA界面建模，但对象非TF-DNA。
abstract: In the effort to discover new targets and improve the therapeutic efficacy of metal-containing anticancer compounds, transition metal complexes that can elicit cytotoxicity when irradiated with light of a proper wavelength and, then, candidates as potential photosensitizers for photodynamic therapy are actively being investigated. In this work, the cytotoxicity in the dark and the photophysical properties of the complex Pt(NwedgeCwedgeN)Cl, where the NwedgeCwedgeN ligand is 2,6-dipyrido-4-methyl-benzene chloride, are investigated in detail by means of a series of theoretical levels, that is density functional theory and its time-dependent extension together with molecular dynamics (MD) simulations. In the dark, cytotoxicity has been explored by simulating the steps of the mechanism of action of classical Pt(II) complexes. The suitability of the investigated complex to act as a photosensitizer has been verified by calculating spectroscopic properties for both the unperturbed complex and its aquated and guanine-bound forms. Furthermore, using MD simulation outcomes as a starting point, the photophysical properties of DNA-intercalated and -bound complexes have been evaluated with the goal of establishing how intercalation and binding affect sensitization activity.
abstract_zh: 在寻找新靶点并提高含金属抗癌化合物疗效的努力中，能够在一定波长光照下引发细胞毒性的过渡金属配合物，以及作为光动力疗法潜在光敏剂的候选物，正被积极研究。本工作中，通过一系列理论水平，即密度泛函理论及其含时扩展结合分子动力学（molecular dynamics, MD）模拟，详细研究了配合物Pt(N^C^N)Cl（其中N^C^N配体为2,6-二吡啶基-4-甲基苯氯化物）在暗处的细胞毒性及其光物理性质。在暗处，通过模拟经典Pt(II)配合物作用机制的步骤，探讨了其细胞毒性。通过计算未受扰动配合物及其水合和鸟嘌呤结合形式的光谱性质，验证了所研究配合物作为光敏剂的适用性。此外，以MD模拟结果作为起点，评估了DNA嵌入和结合配合物的光物理性质，旨在确定嵌入和结合如何影响敏化活性。
